items.title: Hacker gets seven years for breaching Rotterdam and Antwerp ports
items.description: The Amsterdam Court of Appeal sentenced a 44-year-old Dutch national to seven years in prison for multiple crimes, including computer hacking and attempted extortion. [...]

items.title: BreachForums Breached, Exposing 324K Cybercriminals
items.description: A massive data dump reveals real identities and details of administrators and members of the notorious hacker forum.

items.title: GoBruteforcer Botnet Targets 50K-plus Linux Servers
items.description: Researchers detailed a souped-up version of the GoBruteforcer botnet that preys on servers with weak credentials and AI-generated configurations.

items.title: Facebook login thieves now using browser-in-browser trick
items.description: Hackers over the past six months have relied increasingly more on the browser-in-the-browser (BitB) method to trick users into providing Facebook account credentials. [...]

items.title: Navigating Privacy and Cybersecurity Laws in 2026 Will Prove Difficult
items.description: No matter what new laws or regulations make the cut for 2026, it's clear that compliance challenges will persist and federal legislation will be limited.

items.title: FBI Flags Quishing Attacks From North Korean APT
items.description: A state-sponsored threat group tracked as "Kimsuky" sent QR-code-filled phishing emails to US and foreign government agencies, NGOs, and academic institutions.
